title: Canonical Tate coordinates and specified binary affine trace product
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], A=Ring(P), a scheme Y with structure map aY, and the ordered affine tower X_j and p_j [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. Use compact support C_j, shifted Tate powers T_j and unit pullback [def-pur-ordered-affine-trace-data]. Define pullTate by iterating the canonical tensor/pullback comparison at the shifted Tate line and then applying the power to the coefficient-unit pullback. Define appendTate by applying tensor with T_d to the coefficient left unitor [def-pur-compared-coefficient-left-unitor]. On the literal Cartesian last-coordinate square put H_d=q_d^*T_d tensor r_d^*T_1. externalTateIso is tensor of the two pullTate isomorphisms followed by appendTate. Define binaryForward at m=d+1 as the native finite forward product [def-pur-finite-forward-product], followed by compact-support congruence from r_m;p_1=p_(m+1), and compact support of externalTateIso. BinaryProductSpecified(kappa) means there exists an etale-origin proof h for H_m with kappa.inv=binaryForward(h). Using the normalized trace base-change maps [def-pur-normalized-line-trace-base-change], LineBaseChangeEquation is exactly their trace compatibility for a map v over k. UniversalLineBaseChange means that equation over every separated finite-type base B mapping to Y and every separated finite-type X mapping to B over k. These are constructions and predicates, with no factorization assertion.

def BinaryProductSpecified (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (d : ℕ)
    (κ : (compact P Y (d + 2)).obj (tate P Y (d + 2)) ≅
      ((tensor (Ring P) Y).obj ((compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1)))).obj
        ((compact P Y 1).obj (tate P Y 1))) : Prop
